temperature.source: the light disc in use: 0 C in an unheated porch fan, 85 C at its solder points in a closed fan globe (the brain's NTC folds the current back over 85 C, brain/README)

tolerance.source: the LEDs' bin spread is carried in the deck by VBIN at its full 0.4 V per LED, not as a tolerance; the model's own temperature coefficient moves it with the corner

led_model.skip: the model against its datasheet's rows, which are stated at 25 C and 85 C and swept in the deck
